carol_support: Escalation: ACME customer reports intermittent \"Invalid JSON\" from JSON mode streaming. Repro across py-sdk v0.9.1, ts-sdk v1.2.0, go-sdk v0.7. Customer sees parse errors mid-stream.

carol_support: Raw chunks captured on the client (server->client frames) - note the escape split across frames:
```
{"id":"1","output":"{\\\"answer\\\": \\\"Hel\nlo\\\\nworld\\\"}"}
```
(the frame boundary splits the UTF-8/escape sequence inside the embedded JSON string)

mike_eng: Hosted or dedicated? Any headers? :eyes:

carol_support: Hosted. Transfer-Encoding: chunked. Small prompt, consistent when streaming long string outputs with escapes.

anna_sdk: Likely the SDKs try to parse text-chunks immediately instead of buffering. Workaround: buffer bytes and only attempt parse when you detect a full object/ndjson newline. Example (py workaround):
```
import json
buf = b''
for chunk in resp.iter_content(chunk_size=None):
    buf += chunk
    try:
        # raw_decode on a string will raise until a full JSON value is present
        obj, idx = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(buf.decode('utf-8'))
        handle(obj)
        buf = buf[idx:].lstrip()
    except ValueError:
        # incomplete, keep buffering
        continue
```

sam_ts: TS repro matches: fetch() + reader.read() yields Uint8Array fragments; a "\\uXXXX" sequence can be split in the middle -> JSON.parse fails. Approaches:
- buffer bytes and only JSON.parse on a newline/NDJSON separator
- or prefer server-side NDJSON framing ("\n" between records) instead of embedding serialized JSON into a quoted string field

luis_go: In Go, json.Decoder works for streaming JSON objects but fails if server sends a quoted-serialized JSON blob that gets split mid-escape. Two mitigation paths:
1) server: stop embedding JSON inside string fields when streaming, emit proper JSON objects or NDJSON
2) go-sdk: use bufio.Reader + json.Decoder and add buffering to handle partial quoted-strings (harder). I'll prototype a small buffering wrapper.

deploy-bot: CI: python-sdk PR #412 (jsonmode-stream-fix) merged to staging (:white_check_mark:). TS and Go patches open, running tests.

carol_support: Sent workaround and ETA to customer, asked them to validate staging. Filed internal follow-up: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INC-2345 . Closing the immediate escalation once customer verifies. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
